cohort: The study participants were 314 female CrossFit athletes from the United States with a mean age of 36 years.
finding: The prevalence of bothersome urinary incontinence in female CrossFit athletes younger than 40 years is higher than in the general population, while the prevalence of other pelvic floor disorder symptoms is likely similar.
mod_finding: Higher parity and number of vaginal deliveries were associated with urinary incontinence and pelvic organ prolapse symptoms.
